sections.title: Weighing sheet
sections.sql: select i.code,i.name,l.grams,i.allergens from recipe_lines l join ingredients i on i.id=l.ingredient_id where l.recipe_id=$1 order by l.grams desc

sections.title: Cost basis
sections.note: Ingredient costs only; currency must match.

sections.title: Serving and pack
sections.sql: select code,name,yield_g,serving_g,pack_g,pack_g/serving_g as servings_per_pack from recipes where id=$1

sections.title: Calculated values
sections.note: Working calculations, not a print-ready label. Assumes nutrient retention through processing. Unknown means evidence is missing. Applies to weight-based recipes only. A qualified reviewer checks source suitability, processing losses, label rules and rounding.
sections.sql: select nutrient,unit,per_100g,per_serving,unknown_values from recipe_nutrients where id=$1 order by nutrient

sections.title: Outstanding checks
sections.sql: select rule,problem,source from compliance_findings where recipe_id=$1 order by rule

sections.title: Review state
sections.sql: select code,owner,review_state,review_due from review_queue where id=$1

sections.title: Supplier declarations
sections.note: Recorded supplier declarations only. This is not a cross-contact assessment or an approved allergen statement.
sections.sql: select i.code,i.name,i.source,i.spec_review_due,i.allergens from recipe_lines l join ingredients i on i.id=l.ingredient_id where l.recipe_id=$1 order by i.code

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: select reviewer,note,created_at from reviews where recipe_id=$1 order by created_at desc

sections.title: Retained Genesis reports
sections.sql: select filename,sha256,imported_by,created_at from source_exports where recipe_id=$1 order by created_at
